qa_pairs.question: What type of diagram is shown on page 1364-1 of the injection electronics section?
qa_pairs.answer: This is an ENGINE BLOCK DIAGRAM for the S14 engine injection electronics system.

qa_pairs.question: Which relay is shown as 'HOT AT ALL TIMES' in the upper right section of the diagram?
qa_pairs.answer: The OXYGEN SENSOR/FUEL PUMP RELAY is shown as 'HOT AT ALL TIMES' in the upper right section.

qa_pairs.question: What are the two fuel pump components identified in the middle section of the diagram?
qa_pairs.answer: The two fuel pump components are the MAIN FUEL PUMP and the AUXILIARY FUEL PUMP.

qa_pairs.question: What input signals are shown connecting to the Motronic Control Unit?
qa_pairs.answer: The input signals to the Motronic Control Unit are: COOLANT TEMPERATURE INPUT, CLOSED THROTTLE INPUT, WIDE OPEN THROTTLE INPUT, and OXYGEN SENSOR INPUT.

qa_pairs.question: Where is the TDC SENSOR located in relation to the diagnostic connector?
qa_pairs.answer: The TDC SENSOR is located below and to the right of the DIAGNOSTIC CONNECTOR in the upper right portion of the diagram.

qa_pairs.question: What components are shown in the bottom section connected to ground?
qa_pairs.answer: The COOLANT TEMPERATURE SENSOR and THROTTLE SWITCH are shown in the bottom section connected to ground.

qa_pairs.question: Which control functions are identified in the solid state section?
qa_pairs.answer: The solid state section shows IDLE SPEED CONTROL, FUEL PUMP RELAY CONTROL, and various input controls including POWER INPUTS and GROUNDS.

qa_pairs.question: What is the purpose of the SHIELD connection shown near the TDC sensor?
qa_pairs.answer: The SHIELD connection provides electromagnetic shielding for the TDC sensor signal to prevent interference from affecting the timing signal to the Motronic Control Unit.
